# Your package protects revenue. Does it protect your hourly pay?

> Free calculator for independent tutors and coaches: compares a discounted prepaid session package against pay-per-session pricing on effective hourly pay, not just revenue — the package discount can quietly cost more per hour than it saves once missed sessions are made up. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
